title: Can You See Monk Seals in Madeira?
description: You can, but rarely. About 30 monk seals live in the Madeira archipelago, mostly at the Desertas. Where they appear, the rules and what to do if you meet one.
heroAlt: A single monk seal resting on a dark boulder below the cliffs of Deserta Grande
keywords: can you see monk seals in Madeira
what to do if you see a monk seal
